+## reference · CMMS software competitor landscape 2026
+
+- MaintainX: best for mobile‑first teams; free basic tier, $20/user/mo Essential, $65/user/mo Premium; 98 % adoption, 32 % downtime reduction, 30 % cost savings; excellent real‑time communication; mobile app rated “excellent”; multi‑site support in Premium+.
+- osapiens HUB for Maintenance: mobile‑first, SAP ECC/S/4HANA certified, standalone go‑live 1–3 weeks, SAP‑integrated 4–12 weeks; free plan for ≤5 users; enterprise pricing quoted.
+- Limble: deepest asset hierarchy, full lifecycle, drag‑and‑drop work orders, KPI dashboards (MTBF, MTTR, PM compliance); no free tier; pricing via calculator, three plans (Standard, Premium+, Enterprise); longer configuration time.
+- UpKeep: manufacturing compliance focus; detailed checklists, safety docs, meter‑based PM triggers; $24/user/mo Essential, $55/user/mo Premium; strong compliance reporting; mobile app “good”.
+- Tractian: AI‑driven predictive maintenance with proprietary Smart Trac sensors (vibration, temperature); auto‑diagnosis reports; $60/user/mo Standard (5‑user min, annual billing), $100/user/mo Enterprise (10‑user min, annual); sensor bundle quoted separately.
+- Coast: best value for small teams; free plan unlimited work orders, limited history/attachments; paid tiers $28/user/mo Starter, $72/user/mo Pro (monthly) or $25/$65 annually; flexible workflows, mobile app “very good”; limited enterprise features.
+- Fiix (Rockwell Automation): native integration with Allen‑Bradley PLCs, FactoryTalk, Rockwell ERP; free tier, $45/user/mo Basic, $75/user/mo Professional; mobile usability “fair”; AI maintenance insights; best for Rockwell ecosystems.
+- eMaint (Fluke Reliability): integrates directly with Fluke vibration/thermal sensors; two plans (Professional 3‑user min, Enterprise 5‑user min) billed prepaid annual; no per‑user price published; best for facilities with Fluke hardware.
+- Pricing range across vendors: $0 (free tiers) to $100/user/mo (Tractian Enterprise); three vendors (Limble, eMaint, upper UpKeep tiers) quote pricing.
+- Key evaluation criteria: technician adoption speed, mobile performance, PM scheduling flexibility, asset/parts depth, reporting, integration with ERP/sensors, total cost per user including implementation.
+- Recommended selection questions:
+  1. Who uses it daily? (mobile usability critical for technicians)
+  2. What systems must integrate? (ERP, sensors, accounting)
+  3. How many users/sites? (avoid overpaying for unused enterprise features)
+  4. Current maintenance maturity? (simple adoption vs advanced analytics)
+  5. Total cost of ownership? (implementation, training, data migration)
+- Mobile app ratings: MaintainX “excellent”, Limble “very good”, UpKeep “good”, Tractian “very good”, Coast “very good”, Fiix “fair”, eMaint “good”.
+- Multi‑site support: MaintainX (Premium+), Limble, UpKeep, Tractian, Coast (limited), Fiix, eMaint all support multi‑site.
+- IoT/sensor integration: MaintainX via integrations, Limble yes, UpKeep yes, Tractian native, Coast limited, Fiix native (Rockwell), eMaint native (Fluke).
+
 Sources: https://reliamag.com/guides/best-cmms-software-2026/
